title: Remove or conditionalize create_all in app startup
description:
Modify chatbot/api/app.py to remove SQLAlchemy's create_all() call from application startup. Before editing, inspect: the current database initialization logic in chatbot/api/app.py.

Ensure tables are only created via migrations by either:
1. Removing the db.create_all() call entirely
2. Making it conditional (e.g., based on an env var)

After changes, import must still work.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/app.py no longer calls db.create_all() unconditionally at startup
